scenarios.title: File-only Python edit of cluster.tf mentioning ${terraform.workspace} (trial, cloud-platform-infrastructure)

tool_input.command:
python3 -I - <<'EOF'
import re
p='cluster.tf'
s=open(p).read()
pins={'def':'default_ng_19_06_26','mon':'monitoring_ng_19_06_26'}
for short,key in pins.items():
    pat=re.compile(r'(    name       = "\$\{terraform\.workspace\}-%s-ng"\n)'%short)
    assert len(pat.findall(s))==1,short
    s=pat.sub(r'\1    launch_template_name = "%s"\n'%key,s)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
terraform fmt -no-color cluster.tf moved.tf; git diff cluster.tf; git status --short .

scenarios.title: File-only Python edit renaming node group keys (trial, cloud-platform-infrastructure)

tool_input.command:
python3 -I - <<'EOF'
import re
p='cluster.tf'
s=open(p).read()
assert s.count('${terraform.workspace}-def-ng')==1
head,tail=s.split('  eks_managed_node_groups = merge(',1)
block,rest=tail.split('\n  )\n',1)
for k in ['default_ng_19_06_26','monitoring_ng_19_06_26']:
    block=re.sub(r'\b%s( *)= local\.'%k, lambda m:k.replace('_','-')+m.group(1)+'= local.', block)
open(p,'w').write(head+'  eks_managed_node_groups = merge('+block+'\n  )\n'+rest)
EOF
terraform fmt -no-color cluster.tf moved.tf; git diff cluster.tf

scenarios.title: File-only Python edit adding inputs to a copied terragrunt.hcl (trial, terragrunt-infrastructure-live-example)

mkdir mysql-replica && cp mysql/terragrunt.hcl mysql-replica/terragrunt.hcl && python3 -I - <<'EOF'
p='mysql-replica/terragrunt.hcl'
s=open(p).read()
i=s.index('# ----', s.index('terraform {'))

EOF
